upstream_contract.surface: npm package plus Claude Code plugin
upstream_contract.core: verbatim tool-call/result compaction; text messages remain verbatim
upstream_contract.selection: Jev separately scores call retention and result retention
upstream_contract.fitting: staged state fitting, pinned first/recent messages, concurrent request batches
upstream_contract.failure: throws on Jev failure; hook adapter falls back to built-in summary
upstream_contract.transport: injectable JevAsker or native TypeSafe client

upstream_does: owns state fitting and decision semantics
ships tests and a Claude Code plugin
supports injectable transport and native client
local_does: adapts omp JSONL into the upstream Message contract
binds the upstream core to omp's pre-compaction hook
preserves omp-specific result pairing and thinking-drop rules
provides replay fixtures and local integration tests
comparison_to_local_compaction.overlap: The local compaction directory imports fast-jev-compaction; it does not duplicate the upstream core algorithm.
comparison_to_local_compaction.retirement_condition: Retire or shrink local code only if upstream accepts the omp adapter/result-pairing contract and ships an equivalent supported plugin surface. Until then, local integration is the consumer-specific seam, not a competing compactor.
no_claim: The example demonstrates reduction mechanics, not answer quality or safe production rollout.
The local omp hook binding remains an integration claim separate from the upstream package tests.
